comments.value:
I agree they should add a chat ping sound (option) So WE know to look above the player's head instead of their face when communicating.
Also add something what will let us know if a player can't see my chatbox, like if they can only see everyone's friend's chatbox or everyone's.
Also, add a filter option so we don't see the bad words?
(also I think there shouldn't be a spam cooldown lol)
Oh, and adding text to speech sounds cool lol. 
Maybe add color fonts? Some people play with nametags off
so maybe add an option to enable yellow color font for friends on the chatbox since it's still visible when nametags are turned off.

If you ask me the current placement only makes sense when it's from a far. Like seeing someone message you when they can't get to you. So maybe we should consider a distance that it swaps to being over the head? Just an idea to chew on

Update: We have two items in progress that relate to this post:
-A sound when text is sent to the chatbox is planned and in progress.
-Chatbox position: we're working on a prototype for a position slider for head -> feet range to see if that works to cover most of the issues with chatbox position, like covering smaller avatar's heads, etc.

@{627e94e69bf04e1ede28a21b|full_name}: The one-size-fits-all won't work here. Way too often am I with a few friends, some have avatars that are too tall or have huge hats that hide the above-head textbox, but then other friends are laying down so the in-front textbox is in their legs.

The location of the textbox could really use a per-user override too. Unless you can make the textbox not be blocked by the avatar of the writer somehow.
Parts of this request were implemented, other parts weren't!

details:
In addition to the chatbox showing above the player's head, there should be more options.
Add more options to the chatbox so you can spawn the chatbox in front of you, right on your hands, or also make it grabbable so you can move around the text.
People usually look at your face and not above your head where your username is, so the current placement is not good.
There's also something necessary, to make people notice you, when you send a message you should make a little pop sound, so people are aware about that you just typed something.
Right now it's very easy to type and literally get ignored because no one will notice or see it, think about these features that i just said, please.
